name: pacelight
description: Unofficial status bar gauge for your Claude subscription's 5-hour and 7-day usage limits, with pace. Works with Claude Code. Not affiliated with Anthropic.

pacelight.language.description: Language for the status bar and the usage card.

pacelight.showTokens.markdownDescription: Show token usage and the estimated API cost (at Anthropic API list prices) in the usage card. Counted from Claude Code's local transcripts (`~/.claude/projects`), so it covers Claude Code on this computer only.

pacelight.format.markdownDescription:
Custom status bar text. Leave empty for the default layout (both limits normally; only the one near its limit, with its reset time, when one is close).

Tokens: `{five_hour}` / `{seven_day}` percent, `{five_hour_pie}` pie glyph ○◔◑◕●, `{five_hour_reset}` time to reset (e.g. `2h10m`), `{five_hour_pace}` shows “over pace” when usage is ahead of time, `{five_hour_tokens}` tokens used (e.g. `3.9M`), `{five_hour_cost}` estimated API cost (e.g. `$4.90`); same for `seven_day`. `$(icon)` codicons work too.

Example: `$(pulse) 5h {five_hour}% · 7d {seven_day}%`

pacelight.refreshIntervalSeconds.description: How often to query usage, in seconds (minimum 30). All VS Code windows share one result.

pacelight.warningThreshold.description: Show the warning color when either the 5-hour or 7-day usage reaches this percent.

pacelight.errorThreshold.description: Show the error color when either the 5-hour or 7-day usage reaches this percent.
